text: FAA guidance indicates reestablishing the control link when lost and, if unsuccessful, initiating emergency procedures; it also requires the remote PIC to take immediate direct control and to include control-link loss procedures in preflight briefings. Autel EVO Max 4N manuals state that automatic RTH after signal loss will keep trying to reconnect, and if reconnection isn’t established within 10 seconds, a warning is shown and Signal Loss Action is executed; during manual flight, loss of connection causes a slow hover followed by Signal Lost. Unverified incident reports claim loss of control shortly after takeoff, failed Return To Home attempts, and the platform not being located or recovered.
